result.reason: The grant facially covers affiliates, contractors, uncured material breach, and M&A successors, but unchanged provisions negate those protections: clause (e) prohibits access by anyone other than Licensee employees, and Article IV still permits immediate termination for any breach and makes continuation subject to fixed terms and Licensor-controlled renewal. The redline also does not address perpetual and irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. The edits are narrowly targeted and preserve unrelated intent, but the unresolved operative conflicts make the drafting ineffective.
